import unittest

from solution import MemoryWorkspace


class MemoryWorkspaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_create_normalizes_names_and_preserves_order(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('  beta  ')
        workspace.create('alpha')
        committed = workspace.commit()
        self.assertEqual(list(committed), ['beta', 'alpha'])
        self.assertEqual(committed, {'beta': [], 'alpha': []})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            workspace.create(' beta ')

    def test_invalid_names(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        for name in [None, 1, True, []]:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    workspace.create(name)
        for name in ['', '   ', '\n\t']:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    workspace.create(name)

    def test_append_deep_copies_record_and_checks_errors(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('items')
        record = {'nested': {'values': [1]}}
        workspace.append(' items ', record)
        record['nested']['values'].append(2)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            workspace.append('items', [])
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            workspace.append('missing', {})
        self.assertEqual(workspace.commit(), {'items': [{'nested': {'values': [1]}}]})

    def test_commit_snapshot_and_outputs_are_independent(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('items')
        workspace.append('items', {'x': [1]})
        committed = workspace.commit()
        committed['items'][0]['x'].append(2)
        first = workspace.snapshot()
        second = workspace.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(first, {'items': [{'x': [1]}]})
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        first['items'].append({'bad': True})
        self.assertEqual(workspace.snapshot(), {'items': [{'x': [1]}]})
        workspace.append('items', {'x': [3]})
        self.assertEqual(workspace.snapshot(), {'items': [{'x': [1]}]})

    def test_rollback_restores_last_commit_and_returns_fresh_copy(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('a')
        workspace.append('a', {'n': 1})
        workspace.commit()
        workspace.append('a', {'n': 2})
        workspace.create('b')
        rolled_back = workspace.rollback()
        self.assertEqual(rolled_back, {'a': [{'n': 1}]})
        rolled_back['a'][0]['n'] = 99
        self.assertEqual(workspace.rollback(), {'a': [{'n': 1}]})

    def test_rollback_before_any_commit_restores_empty_state(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('temporary')
        self.assertEqual(workspace.rollback(), {})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            workspace.append('temporary', {})

    def test_context_manager_commits_on_success(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        with workspace as entered:
            self.assertIs(entered, workspace)
            entered.create('saved')
            entered.append('saved', {'ok': True})
        self.assertEqual(workspace.snapshot(), {'saved': [{'ok': True}]})

    def test_context_manager_rolls_back_and_propagates_exception(self):
        workspace = MemoryWorkspace()
        workspace.create('saved')
        workspace.append('saved', {'version': 1})
        workspace.commit()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'boom'):
            with workspace as entered:
                entered.append('saved', {'version': 2})
                entered.create('temporary')
                raise RuntimeError('boom')
        self.assertEqual(workspace.commit(), {'saved': [{'version': 1}]})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
